mapper.select: SELECT r.record_id, r.appointment_id, r.pet_id, r.client_id, r.doctor_id, r.chief_complaint, r.diagnosis, r.treatment, r.advice, r.revisit_date, r.origin_record_id, r.fee_register, r.fee_treat, b.fee_drug, b.total_money, b.pay_status, r.create_time, r.status, r.finish_time, r.cancel_reason, p.pet_name, c.client_name, d.doctor_name, dep.department_name FROM medical_record r LEFT JOIN pet p ON r.pet_id = p.pet_id LEFT JOIN client c ON r.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON r.doctor_id = d.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dep ON r.department_id = dep.department_id LEFT JOIN bill b ON b.record_id = r.record_id AND b.is_del = 0 WHERE r.is_del = 0 AND r.pet_id = #{petId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.record_id, r.appointment_id, r.pet_id, r.client_id, r.doctor_id, r.chief_complaint, r.present_illness, r.past_history, r.physical_exam, r.diagnosis, r.treatment, r.advice, r.revisit_date, r.origin_record_id, r.internal_note, r.triage_level, r.weight, r.temperature, r.heart_rate, r.respiratory_rate, r.blood_pressure, r.fee_register, r.fee_treat, b.fee_drug, b.total_money, b.pay_status, r.create_time, r.status, r.finish_time, r.cancel_reason, p.pet_name, c.client_name, d.doctor_name, dep.department_name FROM medical_record r LEFT JOIN pet p ON r.pet_id = p.pet_id LEFT JOIN client c ON r.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON r.doctor_id = d.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dep ON r.department_id = dep.department_id LEFT JOIN bill b ON b.record_id = r.record_id AND b.is_del = 0 WHERE r.is_del = 0 AND r.record_id = #{recordId}

SELECT r.record_id, r.pet_id, r.client_id, r.doctor_id, r.diagnosis, r.create_time, r.status, r.finish_time, r.cancel_reason, p.pet_name, c.client_name, d.doctor_name FROM medical_record r LEFT JOIN pet p ON r.pet_id = p.pet_id LEFT JOIN client c ON r.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON r.doctor_id = d.doctor_id WHERE r.is_del = 0 AND r.doctor_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.record_id, r.pet_id, r.client_id, r.doctor_id, r.diagnosis, r.revisit_date, r.create_time, r.status, r.finish_time, r.cancel_reason, p.pet_name, c.client_name, d.doctor_name FROM medical_record r LEFT JOIN pet p ON r.pet_id = p.pet_id LEFT JOIN client c ON r.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON r.doctor_id = d.doctor_id WHERE r.is_del = 0 AND r.revisit_date IS NOT NULL AND r.revisit_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY r.revisit_date ASC

SELECT p.drug_name AS drugName, p.usage_info AS usageInfo, r.create_time AS createTime FROM prescription p JOIN medical_record r ON p.record_id = r.record_id WHERE r.pet_id = #{petId} AND r.is_del = 0 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT i.item_name AS itemName, i.result_value AS resultValue, i.ref_range AS refRange, i.item_unit AS itemUnit, i.result_time AS resultTime FROM lab_order_item i JOIN lab_order o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN medical_record r ON o.record_id = r.record_id WHERE r.pet_id = #{petId} AND i.is_abnormal = 1 ORDER BY i.result_time DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT r.record_id, r.appointment_id, r.pet_id, r.client_id, r.doctor_id, r.chief_complaint, r.present_illness, r.past_history, r.physical_exam, r.diagnosis, r.treatment, r.advice, r.revisit_date, r.origin_record_id, r.internal_note, r.triage_level, r.weight, r.temperature, r.heart_rate, r.respiratory_rate, r.blood_pressure, r.fee_register, r.fee_treat, b.fee_drug, b.total_money, b.pay_status, r.create_time, r.status, r.finish_time, r.cancel_reason, p.pet_name, c.client_name, d.doctor_name, dep.department_name FROM medical_record r LEFT JOIN pet p ON r.pet_id = p.pet_id LEFT JOIN client c ON r.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON r.doctor_id = d.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dep ON r.department_id = dep.department_id LEFT JOIN bill b ON b.record_id = r.record_id AND b.is_del = 0 WHERE r.is_del = 0 AND r.record_id = #{q.recordId} AND p.pet_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.petName}, '%') AND c.client_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.clientName}, '%') AND d.doctor_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.doctorName}, '%') AND r.diagnosis LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.diagnosis}, '%') AND r.status = #{q.status} AND r.create_time >= #{q.startTime} AND r.create_time <= #{q.endTime} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
